reasoning: The agent shows two distinct modes: on internal correctness bugs (shadow-generation location, O(E²) perf, cycle-vs-shadow) it does genuinely re-trace to a root cause and fix general logic (level 5+ behavior), but on the actual parity/format/algorithm questions it never revisits its model of Java behavior — it never opens the reference and instead hardcodes constants keyed to visible goldens (steps 201-202, 217-218), the exact brittle special-casing the high anchors forbid. Because the dominant response to falsifying diffs is local tweaks and golden-fitting rather than model revision, but with a few real general corrections, it sits just above the level-3 anchor and well short of level 5's consistent re-examination of assumptions.
